name: Runway Gen-3 Alpha
tagline: Runway Gen-3 Alpha is Runway's most advanced video generation model, producing highly consistent, cinematic video clips up to 10 seconds long with superior motion quality and photorealism compared to its predecessors. It supports text-to-video, image-to-video, and video-to-video generation and integrates directly into Runway's full creative suite. Professional filmmakers and VFX studios use it for pre-visualisation, b-roll generation, and experimental visual storytelling.
